get.description: The site's Google Search Console numbers over the last `days` days Search Console has (28 by default), or since a day: Google's own site totals, the change from the period before, and the posts with the most search clicks.
The blog's funnel and every post's part in it: Google impressions and clicks, page views and downloads, over the last `days` days (or since a day) that both Search Console and Umami have.
A post's page views and downloads from Umami, per US Pacific day, at every address the post has had.
The whole site's page views and downloads from Umami, per US Pacific day: every page, the home and release pages too.

Page views and tagged downloads by channel, source, campaign, page or page type, over complete US Pacific days: the whole site, or narrowed to a post, a page type, a channel or a source. Every page of the site counts, not only posts.
Every page of the site with its page views and all its downloads, over complete US Pacific days, most viewed first; optionally one page type.

From channel to page type to download, over complete US Pacific days: page views from each channel to each page type, and each page type's page views and downloads. Both come from the same daily reads, so a page type's page views equal the sum of its channels'.
Tracked links, newest first, with their page views and tagged downloads over the last `days` complete days the CMS has, or since a day.

post.description: Makes a tracked link: where it is shared decides utm_source and utm_medium (creator, partner and ad add `who` as the source); the campaign and optional content are lowercase words joined by hyphens. A link with the same page and tags exists only once.

A quarter's objectives (default: the current one), newest first, each key result with its progress from the CMS's numbers.
